about: Evaluations for skills/sonore-sdk, in the shape Anthropic's skill guide suggests: a request, and behaviour that can be checked. Run each with the skill and the sonore-sdk MCP server installed, in a fresh SDK checkout, on more than one model.

evaluations.query: Make me a stereo gain plugin with a dB control from -24 to +12, built on the Sonore SDK.
expected_behavior: Starts from sdk/cmake/sonore_new_plugin.cmake rather than writing CMake by hand
Converts decibels with sonore::dbToGain and smooths the control with sonore::Smooth
Allocates nothing in process(); any buffer is sized in prepare()
Builds in Release, runs ctest, and runs clap-validator and pluginval at strictness 10, or says which of them were not run

evaluations.query: Add a look-ahead limiter with 5 ms of look-ahead to my Sonore plugin.
expected_behavior: Looks the limiter up (sonore_search) before naming a class
Declares int latencySamples() const and returns the look-ahead in samples at the current rate
Computes the look-ahead from the sample rate in prepare(), not from a fixed 44100 or 48000

evaluations.query: Use the SDK's CompressorPro class to add a compressor.
expected_behavior: Searches for CompressorPro and reports that the SDK has no such class
Does not write code that uses CompressorPro
Offers what the SDK does have (Compressor, or the compressors in compressors.h) after reading its declaration

evaluations.query: Turn my Sonore effect into a polyphonic instrument.
expected_behavior: Changes the process signature to take a sonore::MidiBuffer&, which is what makes it an instrument
Sets the descriptor's instrument flag to true
Reads an instrument example (sonore_example with kind instrument) or starts from -DTYPE=instrument

evaluations.query: Add a spectrum analyzer to the web page of my Sonore plugin.
expected_behavior: Looks the spectrum up (sonore_search) and draws from sonore.onSpectrum rather than inventing data
Does not animate the display with Math.random, a sine or a timer of its own
Treats each frame as 256 dBFS points on the fixed 20 Hz to 20 kHz log grid, not as raw FFT bins
Says that LV2 does not feed a spectrum yet if the plugin is built as LV2
